clinical_intent: I have a 60-year-old female with a 4 cm endometrial cancer (Grade 3, Stage IB) who is a professional opera singer. She had a total hysterectomy with BSO and pelvic lymphadenectomy (negative nodes). She needs adjuvant therapy. She is very concerned about vaginal stenosis and its impact on her singing career (she uses her pelvic floor extensively for singing technique). She wants to minimize treatment-related side effects. Should I recommend vaginal cuff brachytherapy alone or combined EBRT and brachytherapy? What fractionation would minimize vaginal side effects? What vaginal dilation protocol should I recommend?
